agreed_faults.text: Two model ids of only punctuation have the same empty slug, so a registry row with the id "." gave its price to the model id "-".
agreed_faults.fix: An empty slug is no match.

agreed_faults.text: A token field with text that is not a number raised ValueError and stopped the cost selection for the job.
agreed_faults.fix: Such a field counts as 0 and is reported as unknown.

agreed_faults.text: The lookup of a Codex session file accepted an id that is only the end of a different session id.
agreed_faults.fix: The lookup accepts the file of exactly one id.

agreed_faults.text: The module text said that only a text that starts with the accumulated text is absorbed. The code also absorbs a text equal to it apart from whitespace at the two ends.
agreed_faults.fix: The sentence names the second case.

agreed_faults.text: The docstring said that billing is the posture of the caller. An existing entry with a known billing keeps its own.
